claims.text: The transaction obtained a raw predictproba score of 0.926495, a calibrated probability of 0.846154, and reached high risk band status above the alert threshold of 0.258181 and high threshold of 0.788025 at time step 39.
Features f53, f59, f163, f138, and f100 pushed the score up.

The model health check status was ok at time step 39 with a reference recall of 0.98308, window recall of 0.937255 across window steps 35, 36, and 37, a lag of 2, and 255 illicit instances in the window.

The subgraph analysis within radius 2 showed 4 nodes, 3 edges, a density of 0.25, focal in-degree of 0, focal out-degree of 1, max in-degree of 1, max out-degree of 2, 3 alerted nodes, a share alerted of 0.75, focal chain length of 0, and a weakly connected component size of 2760.

Neighbor analysis at 2 hops out found 3 neighbors, consisting of transaction 148545913 at hop 1 with score 0.522331 and alert status true, transaction 113649806 at hop 2 with score 0.714648 and alert status true, and transaction 64307248 at hop 2 with score 0.207885 and alert status false.

limitations: The Elliptic dataset has no wallet addresses, names, amounts or dates, so none of these appear in this memo.
The model's recall collapsed after time step 43 (a dark-market shutdown), and the model-health check only detects such a collapse several steps later, so scores at later time steps may be unreliable.
Regulation retrieval is weak (hybrid hit@3 about 0.6 on a small test set): retrieved passages are leads for an analyst, not verified authorities, and text from the India document comes from OCR.
Scores are raw gradient-boosting outputs, not calibrated probabilities; the calibrated value shifts with the prevalence of illicit activity.
Structural patterns are resemblances only: Elliptic has no typology labels.
The model-health monitor uses labels with a 2-step lag and a 3-step window, so it cannot flag a collapse in its first steps. On this dataset it first flags at step 47.
This is a draft for a human analyst. It does not decide whether a report should be filed.
